issues.description: The source subtitle is a single line with clear separation below the title, but the rendered subtitle sits too close to the title and wraps the final character onto an isolated second line, materially disrupting the title/subtitle hierarchy.

background_seams.rationale: The pale background and corner decorations remain continuous, with no hard rectangular seams or mismatched local surface colors.

connector_endpoints.rationale: The source contains no arrowheads or connector endpoints requiring attachment or direction review.

connector_topology.rationale: The source contains no semantic process connectors; the three horizontal rules are internal card dividers rather than directional relationships.

crop_boundaries.rationale: The source uses native-looking text and geometric shapes and contains no cropped artwork or circular raster asset whose boundary could leak.

key_proportions.rationale: The three card sizes, gaps, badge scale, footer bar, and decorative corner ellipses retain the source proportions and visual balance.

typography_hierarchy.rationale: The rendered subtitle wraps its final character to a second line and crowds the title instead of preserving the source's clean single-line hierarchy.

visual_depth.rationale: The source's intentionally flat treatment, subtle card outlines, translucent decorative layers, and fill hierarchy are preserved without visible flattening loss.
